# Reference-site audit

Accessed 27 September 2026. This is a bounded public-page research pass, not an exhaustive listing inventory or a visual interaction audit of third-party sites.

## Claude Marketplaces

Source: https://claudemarketplaces.com/

Observed: separate Skills, MCP Servers and Marketplaces indexes; category navigation; resource summaries; source and installation paths; advertising and independent-project disclosures.

Adapted: distinct resource types and a concise route into technical detail. No rankings, popularity counts, copy, assets or installation commands were reproduced.

## Claude Skills Hub

Source: https://claudeskills.info/mcp/

Observed: keyword search, deployment/source filters, sorting, a distinction between hosted services and repositories, and affiliate disclosure.

Adapted: explicit filtering and commercial relationship labels. Registry verification claims were not transferred to our own catalogue.

## MCP Market

Source: https://mcpmarket.com/tools/skills

Observed: category discovery, resource cards, recent/popular sections, and paid-resource labels.

Adapted: compact cards with resource type, licence, source and maintenance status. No popularity data, rankings or premium content was collected.

## Claude Skills MCP historical listing

Source: https://www.claudemarketplace.net/mcp/claude-skills-mcp

Observed: a deprecation notice alongside older technical and installation content.

Adapted: maintenance warnings precede technical detail. The directory's historical entry is labelled separately from primary-source reviews and has no install action.

## Boundaries and limitations

- Read public pages through the web research tool. No bulk collection, crawling or source snapshots.
- No access controls were bypassed and no private endpoints were used.
- Robots/terms were not evaluated for automated bulk ingestion; no authorization for such ingestion is asserted.
- Reference-site responsive behavior and keyboard interaction were not tested.
- Our interfaces, summaries, typography and components are original.
- Primary-source research supplements the reference directories with legal-domain samples; not every sample is claimed to have been discovered through a reference listing.
